description.value: Sharetea is a Taiwanese bubble tea chain founded in 1992, now operating over 400 stores worldwide, including this Coquitlam location. The menu spans classic milk teas, fruit teas, matcha, and ice-blended drinks, all made to order with ingredients sourced from Taiwan. Cyclists looking for a cold, customizable drink stop in Coquitlam will find a wide range of caffeinated and non-caffeinated options.

OSM confirms takeaway=yes and air_conditioning=yes, and the website FAQ corroborates dairy-alternative milk substitutions (oat, almond, soy milk) and gluten-free tapioca pearls, supporting a vegetarian/vegan/GF value.
